texto: It matches the first plural person of the present: **andiamo!** (come on!), **vediamo!** (see!), **partiamo!** (come out!). It serves to include in the action and invite the group to act together.

It fully matches the indicative present of each conjugation: **-are → -ate** (**ascoltate!**), **-ere → -ete** (**prendete!**), **-ire → -ite** (**dormite!**). For the plural negative it is simply added **non** in front of the conjugated form: **non parlate!**, **non prendete!**.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: collective appeals and collective instructions

frases.it: C'è molta gente all'ingresso della clinica medica.
frases.es: Hay mucha gente en la entrada de la clínica médica.
frases.en: There are a lot of people at the entrance to the medical clinic.
analisis: at the entrance of the clinic

frases.it: Sì: prendiamo il numero d'ordine e aspettiamo il nostro turno.
frases.es: Sí: cojamos el número de turno y esperemos nuestro turno.
frases.en: Yeah, let's take the shift number and wait for our shift.

frases.it: Guardate il cartello: «Prendete il biglietto e aspettate in sala».
frases.es: Mirad el cartel: «Tomad el billete y esperad en la sala».
frases.en: Look at the sign: «Take the ticket and wait in the room.».

frases.it: Perfetto! Sediamoci qui e non facciamo confusione mentre chiamano.
frases.es: ¡Perfecto! Sentémonos aquí y no hagamos ruido mientras llaman.
frases.en: Perfect! Let's sit here and make no noise while they call.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «Let's go see the museum.» as a proposal for the whole group (noi)?

opciones.explicacion: The collective form of «noi» adopts regular «-iamo» deinence.
That is an exclusive order for you («voi»).
It describes a third-person plural action («They go.»).

bloques.pregunta: What is the form of «voi»'s affirmative imperative for «prendere»?

opciones.explicacion: The verbs in -ere form the «voi» imperative with the «-ete» deinence.
It is the individual form directed to «You».
It is the formal form of courtesy for «You» (Lei).

bloques.frase: Ragazzi, ___ il biglietto alla cassa e aspettate il vostro turno.

opciones.explicacion: Second person from the regular plural for verbs in -ere.

bloques.frase: Andiamo insieme a prendere un caffè prima della riunione.

opciones.texto: Una acción conjunta compartida por el hablante y sus interlocutores.
opciones.explicacion: «Andiamo» functions as a collective invitation in the first person of the plural.

opciones.texto: Una instrucción estricta dirigida exclusivamente a subordinados.
opciones.explicacion: It actively includes the issuer in the proposal.

opciones.texto: La prohibición terminante de consumir café en horario laboral.
opciones.explicacion: He proposes to have a coffee, he doesn't forbid it.

bloques.pregunta: Who is the subject of the instruction?
bloques.frase: Non parlate tutti insieme: ascoltate con attenzione il medico.

opciones.explicacion: «Non parlate» and «ascoltate» are specific forms of the second plural person.

opciones.texto: A single patient treated you formally.
opciones.explicacion: With «Lei» it would be «non parli» and «ascolti».

opciones.texto: The doctor himself who's going through the room.
opciones.explicacion: The recipients are the group listeners.

bloques.frase: Prendete il numero e aspettate il turno
bloques.traduccion: Take the number and wait for the shift.

bloques.pregunta: How is the «Don't open the door.» ban made for «voi»?

opciones.explicacion: The negative plural imperative is built with «non» followed by the present of voi («aprite»).
It corresponds to the formal plural treatment of third person (Loro).

intro: Learn to make collective proposals with «noi» and instructions to groups with «voi».
